title: 情态动词表推测

examples.en: He must be at home. The light is on.
He can't be at home. I saw him go out.
examples.zh: 他不可能在家，我看见他出去了。

options.feedback: 对！否定推测“不可能”用 can't，不用 mustn't。
不对——mustn't 只表示“禁止”，从来不用于推测。
不对——needn't 是“不必”，不表示推测。

rule.rule: 肯定推测用 must（一定，把握大）；否定推测用 can't（不可能）；把握不大时用 may / might（可能）；对过去的情况推测用“情态动词 + have + 过去分词”
rule.formula: ① must + 动词原形：一定　② can't + 动词原形：不可能　③ may / might + 动词原形：可能　④ 对过去：must have done（一定做过） / can't have done（不可能做过）

anchors.en: The light is on. He must be in the office.
anchors.zh: 灯亮着，他一定在办公室。

anchors.en: He can't be a teacher. He is only fifteen.
anchors.zh: 他不可能是老师，他才十五岁。

trap.wrong: He mustn't be at home.（想表达“他不可能在家”）
trap.why: mustn't 表示禁止，不用于推测；否定推测只能用 can't。

guess_callback: 你刚才选的是 A——肯定推测 must，否定推测 can't，把握不大用 may。

check.stem: Look at that boy over there. He ____ be Tom — Tom is much taller.

options.distractor: must 是肯定推测，与后句矛盾
后句给出了确定的排除理由

check.explanation: 个子差很多 → 不可能是 Tom：can't be。

check.stem: — Whose bag is this? — It ____ be Lucy's. Her name is on it.

options.distractor: 上面有名字，是肯定推测
有名字作证据，把握很大

check.explanation: 上面写着名字 → 一定是她的：must be。

options.text: He can't be at school. It's Sunday today.
He mustn't be at school. It's Sunday today.
He needn't be at school. It's Sunday today.
options.distractor: needn't 是“不必”，不是“不可能”

options.text: He shouldn't be at school. It's Sunday today.
options.distractor: shouldn't 是“不应该”，不是推测
